Your World. Your Rules. Your Brookhaven.
PLAY

EVERYONE IS WELCOME IN BROOKHAVEN
Brookhaven is a town built by everyone in it. A place where everyone belongs. A place for community, discovery, and curiosity.
Create Your World.
Houses, shops, a school, a hospital, the works. Run a cafe today, a fire station tomorrow. Pick where you live. Drive any car you want. It's all yours.
Play with New and Old Friends.
There are millions of players a day in Brookhaven. Some are throwing birthday parties. Some are hanging out at the fountain. Your friends are probably already here.
Explore and Discover.
Brookhaven has a secret. People have been finding pieces of it for years. Strange doors. Glowing rooms. Stuff that wasn't there yesterday. Solve Brookhaven mysteries.
WELCOME TO BROOKHAVEN!
Create, discover, role play and explore in Brookhaven- it's your world!
PLAY NOW
DISCOVER
Three of the hottest spots in Brookhaven.
BROOKHAVEN HIGH SCHOOL
Where everyone meets everyone. The class is optional. The drama isn't.
JETT'S JUNGLE NUGGETS
Just opened. Cook your own jungle nuggets. Crank the jukebox.
Listen to the new record
.
BIG FRANK'S MOTORS
Drive home in something fast. Come back when you're tired of it.

🐾 Pet Simulator 99!
August 29, 2026
Lucky Block Blitz!
🎯 BLAST your pets at Lucky Blocks! ✨ New pets with SPECIAL ABILITIES! 🧲 Build with BUMPERS! 🗝️ KEYS can unlock the Gargantuan! ⏱️ Beat the TIME TRIAL clock! 🥇 Good luck in the LEAGUE!
Lucky Block Blitz
BLAST
your pets, drop
Bumpers
, and race the
Time Trial
!
New pets
, new
SPECIAL ABILITIES
and the
GARGANTUAN
is BACK!
News
📽️ Partner Applications
Partner Applications
are OPEN right now!
Join the
BIG Games Partner Program
and level up your content!
Read the
requirements
in the form, then apply by
Sunday, September 6
!
Apply right here!
Featuring
🎯 Block Blaster
Your pets are the
AMMO
now!
Switch on the
Block Blaster
and it fires your equipped pets at the blocks!
Every shot flies in with its
special ability
loaded.
Unlock it at the
Upgrade Machine
, then level its
fire rate
and
damage
!
✨ Special Abilities
Every
Lucky Block
pet now has its own
special ability
! (including last week's)
Pierce
- Drills straight through a line of blocks
Splash
- Damages every block around the one it hits
Scatter
- Has a chance to burst into a spray of mini pets
Momentum
- Every bounce makes it faster and hit harder
Payout
- Hits softer, but pays out Breakout Coins and surprise MEGA bonuses
Rarer pets pack
stronger
versions, so climb the roster!
Mix your pet equips up and stack every ability at once!
🧲 Bumpers
Drop
Bumpers
around the edge of your board!
Deflector Bumper
- Bounces your pets straight back into the blocks
Magnet Bumper
- Bends your pets toward the thickest wall of blocks
Start with a
FREE Deflector
, and hunt
Lucky Blocks
for rare extras.
Unlock more
Bumper Slots
, then move them any time, even after a
Rebirth
!
⏱️ Time Trial
Step on the
Time Trial
pad and race the clock!
You get
10 minutes
. Get as
FAR
as you can!
Everyone faces the same blocks, no matter their
Rebirth
.
3 runs
a day, and every drop you smash is yours to keep.
Set your best run to top the Time Trial Leaderboard!
♻️ Fresh Start
Everyone restarts at
Rebirth 0
for round two, so the race starts
even
!
Coins
and
Bucks
reset once, but every
pet
,
Egg Tier
, and
Bumper
stays.
From there,
no cap
on Rebirths, and
Breakout Coins
carry through every one!
Limited Pets
💪 Gargantuan Returns
Missed the
GARGANTUAN Lucky Block Angelus
? It's back!
Find a
Lucky Gargantuan Key
and open the
Gargantuan Chest
to chase it!
Every key opens the chest on the
spot
, no waiting around.
Run the
Boost Machine
first to crank up your odds!
The rarest pet in the whole event!
🔥 Limited Titanic Pets
Check out these sweet
TITANIC
pets!
Titanic Lucky Bearserker
- Lucky Blocks and the Titanic Chest
Titanic Lucky Surprise Dragon
- Top the Time Trial Leaderboard and League
⭐ Limited Huge Pets
A wave of new
HUGE
pets have arrived!
Huge Lucky Surprise Axolotl
- Lucky Blocks and both Chests
Huge Lucky Sticky Hedgehog
- Found in the Lucky Admin Gift
Huge Lucky Stacked Agony
- Top the Time Trial Leaderboard and League
🐾 New Pets
Collect
9
brand-new
Lucky Block
pets!
Start with the
Lucky Sticky Lamb
and climb to the ultra-rare
Lucky Chest Mimic
!
Every one out-hits last week's pets, with a fresh
ability
to match.
Your
Golden
,
Rainbow
, and
Shiny
pets now bounce in full color!
🐣 More Lucky Eggs
5
brand-new
Lucky Eggs
stack on top of the ladder!
Level
Better Eggs
at the Upgrade Machine to unlock each one.
The
final Lucky Egg
hatches rotating
Active Huge
pets too.
Every new egg holds a
rarer
pet than the last.
Event
❔ More Lucky Blocks
4
new colors join the ladder,
12
in all!
Smash into
Orange
,
Red
,
Black
, and
RAINBOW
Lucky Blocks!
The toughest blocks take
12 solid hits
to clear!
Every smash rolls for
Coins
,
Diamonds
,
Keys
, and
Gifts
!
Spot a
GIANT Rainbow Boss
? It's twice as tough, but drops
3x the Gifts
!
🗝️ Lucky Keys
The
Titanic
and
Gargantuan Chests
now open with
KEYS
!
Lucky Titanic Keys
and
Lucky Gargantuan Keys
drop straight from Lucky Blocks.
The hourly timer is
gone
, so stack keys and open a pile at once!
Level
Chest Luck
to roll every key even more times!
Save your keys for when a Boost Machine bar is running!
🍀 Boost Machine
Feed the
Boost Machine
your
Breakout Coins
!
It boosts your
Huge
,
Titanic
, and
Gargantuan
chest luck.
Stack up to
6 hours
per boost, then go crack some keys!
🎁 Lucky Admin Gift
Crack open the brand-new
Lucky Admin Gift
!
Stuffed with
Diamonds
,
Breakout Bucks
,
Lucky Boosts
, and rare
enchants
.
Push your luck for the
HUGE Lucky Sticky Hedgehog
hiding inside!
Smash
Lucky Blocks
for a rare drop, and level
Lucky Bag Drops
to find more.

Tier III
Lucky Boosts are here, the strongest yet!
Lucky Damage Boost III
- 5x ball damage for 30 minutes
Lucky Speed Boost III
- 2.5x ball speed for 30 minutes
Lucky Egg Booster III
- +100% luck on every Lucky Egg for 30 minutes
They drop from the
Lucky Admin Gift
!

3
brand-new tracks join the
Upgrade Machine
!
Blaster
- Fire your pets faster
Blaster Damage
- Fired pets hit harder
Bumper Slots
- Place more Bumpers around your board
Better Eggs
now climbs
9 tiers
to unlock every new egg.
Flip on
Auto Buy
and set the
order
it buys in!
Bumper Slots stick through Rebirth, so buy them early!

League
crowns the squad that unlocks the most
stages
!

squad of 4
, every
stage
anyone unlocks counts!
Stages count again after every
Rebirth

!

Huge Lucky Stacked Agony
Every member
in your squad gets the prize!
Good luck!

furthest
in a single
Time Trial
run!
Only your
best run
counts, so make all
3
daily tries matter.

!
Every hatch is a top-tier
stat pet
, ready to bounce.
Push your luck for the
Huge Lucky Block Demon
or
Titanic Lucky Chest Mimic
!
Every
TITANIC
hatch also drops a

, the strongest pet in the event!
Grab
10
or
100
to stack
Exclusive Raffle Tickets
!

Loot Pack
!

,

, and
Exclusive Eggs
.
Loaded with
50 Tier III Boosts
and a stack of
Mega Chests
!
Limited-time only!

forever with the
Forever Pack
!

and

!

Lucky Admin Eggs
